d: Jharkhand ke dumka jile men khanan chalan aur royalti katauti ki naee vyavastha lagu hone ke bad se sanvedkon (thekedaron) ki mushkilen kaphi barh gaee hain. khan evan bhutatv vibhag dvara jari patrank 197 aur 2506 ke virodh men sanvedkon ne upayukt ko gyapan saunpkar purani vyavastha ko bahal karne ki mang ki hai.
